nodes.name: DIAGRAM.md
nodes.summary: Backend architecture documentation with Mermaid diagrams covering package structure, domain interfaces, cache-backed read flow, the versioning pending-change/commit lifecycle, version reconstruction, authentication, service-layer dependencies, and an API endpoints overview.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Mermaid code fences to render class, sequence, and dependency diagrams inline.

nodes.name: config.yaml
nodes.summary: Runtime configuration for the backend covering server host/port, database connection, file storage, cache, authentication (including super-admin local account), and versioning behavior.

nodes.name: go.mod
nodes.summary: Go module definition declaring the module path github.com/jerome-godbout-lychens/project_works/backend and pinning the Go 1.23 toolchain.

nodes.name: openapi.yaml
nodes.summary: OpenAPI 3 specification defining the complete backend REST contract: auth, projects and folders, elements, links, versions and diffs, attachments, custom field definitions and values, phases, users, groups and membership, project access control, and API keys.
nodes.languageNotes: OpenAPI 3 document with ~36 path templates grouped by resource; the YAML parser could not be machine-read so endpoint grouping was derived from the raw path list.

nodes.name: auth
nodes.summary: Authentication endpoints: OAuth login, callback, logout, and current-user (/auth/login, /auth/callback, /auth/logout, /auth/me).

nodes.name: projects
nodes.summary: Project and folder management endpoints including listing, creation, folder hierarchy, and per-project retrieval/update (/projects, /projects/folders, /projects/{project_identifier}).

nodes.name: elements
nodes.summary: Element CRUD and search endpoints scoped to a project, plus standalone element access (/projects/{project_identifier}/elements, /elements/{element_identifier}, /elements/search).

nodes.name: links
nodes.summary: Element link management endpoints for creating links from an element and operating on a single link (/elements/{element_identifier}/links, /links/{link_identifier}).

nodes.name: versions
nodes.summary: Element version history endpoints: list versions, fetch a specific version, and diff between versions (/elements/{element_identifier}/versions[/{version_number}][/diff]).

nodes.name: attachments
nodes.summary: File attachment endpoints for listing/uploading on an element and accessing a single attachment (/elements/{element_identifier}/attachments, /attachments/{attachment_identifier}).

nodes.name: custom-fields
nodes.summary: Custom field endpoints covering per-project field definitions and per-element field values (/projects/{project_identifier}/custom-field-definitions, /elements/{element_identifier}/custom-field-values).

nodes.name: phases
nodes.summary: Project phase endpoints for listing/creating phases and operating on a single phase (/projects/{project_identifier}/phases, /phases/{phase_identifier}).

nodes.name: users
nodes.summary: User management endpoints for listing users, single-user access, and a user's group memberships (/users, /users/{user_identifier}, /users/{user_identifier}/groups).

nodes.name: groups
nodes.summary: Group endpoints covering group CRUD, membership management, and group access listings (/groups, /groups/{group_identifier}, /groups/{group_identifier}/members[/{user_identifier}], /groups/{group_identifier}/access).

nodes.name: access
nodes.summary: Project access-control endpoints for granting/revoking group access to projects and checking access (/projects/{project_identifier}/access[/{group_identifier}], /projects/{project_identifier}/access/check).

nodes.name: api-keys
nodes.summary: API key endpoints for listing/creating automation keys and operating on a single key (/api-keys, /api-keys/{api_key_identifier}).
